integrity: The primary preprint was inspected at the exact Section 6 integral estimates, normalized-coordinate construction, qualitative subunit-order theorem, and sharp order-zero theorem. The new proof parameterizes the source radius-selection dilation, combines it with the actual translation inequalities, and takes a controlled two-parameter limit. The order-one-half constant and unit-order asymptotic are derived symbolically. No numerical experiment is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The lower bound is not claimed sharp for positive orders below one. It requires ordinary order rho<1, gives only a limsup density estimate, and does not treat curves known only to have lower order below one. An older lower-order defect-relation paper was accessible only through its published abstract and remains a residual literature risk.
title: Quantitative inflection density below unit order for holomorphic curves
